## Overview

This project is an **advanced RAG comparison framework** with **six methods**—four focused on **chunking technology** (overlap, sentence, recursive, semantic) plus **contextual retrieval** and **vector database hybrid search**.

**GitHub:** [sophalchan/rag-methods-comparison-lab](https://github.com/sophalchan/rag-methods-comparison-lab)

**Stack:** Python · sentence-transformers · ChromaDB · rank-bm25 · Flask

## Background of the Study

Chunking quality drives RAG accuracy. Fixed word splits can break sentences. **Sentence windows** and **recursive hierarchical** splitting respect document structure ([Pinecone — Chunking Strategies](https://www.pinecone.io/learn/chunking-strategies/)). **Semantic breakpoint** chunking groups text until embedding similarity drops—similar in spirit to Kamradt semantic chunking. **Contextual retrieval** enriches each chunk with parent document context before embedding.

## Six RAG Methods

| # | Method | What it does |
|---|--------|----------------|
| 1 | **Fixed overlap chunking** | Word windows with configurable **overlap** (sliding window) |
| 2 | **Sentence window chunking** | Groups **sentences**; **overlapping sentences** between chunks |
| 3 | **Recursive hierarchical** | Splits by `\n\n` → `\n` → `. ` → words (LangChain-style) |
| 4 | **Semantic breakpoint** | Breaks chunks when **embedding similarity** between sentences falls below threshold |
| 5 | **Contextual retrieval** | Prepends **document title + category + summary** to each chunk |
| 6 | **Vector DB hybrid** | **Chroma** cosine search + **BM25** keywords fused with **RRF** |

## Motivation of the Study

- Teach and test **multiple chunking algorithms** on the same corpus  
- Store **chunking_strategy** metadata in Chroma for debugging  
- Report **chunk statistics** (count, avg/min/max tokens) per method  
- Compare retrieval on identical queries across pipelines  
- Bridge coursework (prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning) with production patterns  

## Step-by-Step Workflow

### Step 1 — Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sophalchan/rag-methods-comparison-lab.git
cd rag-methods-comparison-lab
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Step 2 — Preview chunking (no embedding yet)

```bash
python scripts/chunk_stats.py
```

Compare how many chunks each method produces and average token size.

### Step 3 — Fixed overlap + sentence window

```bash
python scripts/build_index.py fixed_overlap_chunking
python scripts/build_index.py sentence_window_chunking
python scripts/query.py sentence_window_chunking "HIPAA access control requirements"
```

### Step 4 — Recursive hierarchical + semantic breakpoints

```bash
python scripts/build_index.py recursive_hierarchical_chunking
python scripts/build_index.py semantic_breakpoint_chunking
python scripts/query.py semantic_breakpoint_chunking "topic shift chunking RAG"
```

### Step 5 — Contextual retrieval + vector DB hybrid

```bash
python scripts/build_index.py contextual_retrieval
python scripts/build_index.py vector_db_hybrid
python scripts/query.py vector_db_hybrid "BM25 hybrid vector database"
```

### Step 6 — Compare all six methods

```bash
python scripts/compare_all.py
```

### Step 7 — Flask API

```bash
python app.py
curl -X POST http://localhost:8090/ask -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"method":"semantic_breakpoint_chunking","question":"Explain sentence overlap chunking"}'
```

## Tools & Framework

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/chunking/strategies.py` | All chunking algorithms |
| `configs/*.yaml` | Per-method hyperparameters |
| `src/vector_store.py` | ChromaDB persistence |
| `src/hybrid_search.py` | BM25 + reciprocal rank fusion |
| `scripts/chunk_stats.py` | Chunk analytics preview |
| `scripts/compare_all.py` | Side-by-side retrieval comparison |

## Outcomes & Skills Gained

- Advanced **chunking** (overlap, sentence, recursive, semantic)  
- **Contextual RAG** and **hybrid vector DB** retrieval

- **Chroma metadata** for chunking strategy traceability
